action.command: head -50 /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.threads; echo "count: $(wc -l < /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.threads)"; echo ---; for t in $(head -20 /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.threads); do if [ -d /proc/$t ]; then echo "$t alive: $(cat /proc/$t/comm 2>/dev/null)"; else echo "$t dead"; fi; done

tool_call.name: terminal
